meta.scope: S031 eLife Version of Record correction: functional methods, behavior modality, and figure-specific sample-size boundary

records.title: Neural substrates of cold nociception in Drosophila larva

decisions.notes: Rechecked against the eLife Version of Record (DOI 10.7554/eLife.91582.3). Figures 1-4 and Methods > CaMPARI imaging verify connectome anatomy; 6 deg C cold-evoked CaMPARI2 sensory/Basin responses; CIII md optogenetic activation and postsynaptic GCaMP6m responses; cell-type silencing/coactivation; and contraction behavior. Figure-specific Ns and units are retained separately; no overall sample size is inferred. No subjective-pain, human ECAP/SCS, or cross-species-transfer outcome is measured. The existing evidence_role simulation_foundation is retained, matching S761 and describing intended mechanistic use rather than an article simulation. Card-level sample_size remains null; per-figure Ns are kept separate.

updates.датасет: Larval CNS connectome plus figure-specific cold-evoked calcium and contraction measurements; sample sizes vary by assay and figure.
updates.ограничения: The Version of Record reports EM connectivity, CaMPARI2 and GCaMP6m activity assays, optogenetic activation/coactivation, cell-type silencing, and larval contraction. These are distinct anatomical, neural, and behavioral measures. Figure-specific sample sizes and units are not combined into one card-level denominator. The work does not measure subjective pain, human ECAP, SCS response, or cross-species transfer.

evidence.sample_size.reason: No single cross-assay sample size is reported. Figure captions provide assay-specific counts and units: Fig. 1B-C CaMPARI2 n=32 per sensory cell type and condition; Fig. 1D cold-behavior average n=72; Fig. 2 Basin silencing average n=68 and CIII/Basin coactivation control n=143 with experimental average n=49; Fig. 3 Basin CaMPARI2 average n=197/27/119/46 and CIII-to-Basin GCaMP6m average n=13 per genotype; Fig. 4 cold-behavior average n=64 and coactivation control n=143 with experimental average n=33. Keep these figure-specific denominators separate; leave the global sample_size null.
